g.text: LazyStateCache — three CachePolicy modes and the LRU tick-clock eviction
keep every computed state, no eviction
The clock is a monotonic logical counter: every touch increments it and
stamps the entry's last_access. The min-heap top is always the least-recently-
used state, so when the resident set exceeds m the top is popped and evicted.
A stale heap entry (an id touched again after it was pushed) is skipped on pop.
